notes: Last caption no longer hangs over the ending — everywhere. The final word's transcriber end (often stretched to the end of the audio) used to freeze the last caption over trailing b-roll / the packshot; three places forced this (build_events, the 'hold last caption to end' in preview, and hold_last in the renderer + the 'exact' server preview). Now the last caption gets a short readable tail (~1.5s) and is trimmed to a scene cut if one was placed before the packshot — preview, exact and render all match. New: invisible caption break — press Enter (or type *) between words to split the caption at that spot; it's invisible in the burned caption and layout-independent, so you can keep punctuation on and still control splits. Replaces the old Manual line breaks toggle; the Punctuation toggle now sits in its place. keep-together phrases now persist across updates (stored next to the shared library / in ~/.assembler, not inside the auto-updated code).
